The CoWoS sources disagree on the base (595k, 780k, 800-850k wafers). Share figures marked forecast or estimate are analysts', not company disclosures. The 'about $5.1m of revenue per employee' is derived (215.9bn / 42,000), not stated by a source. The compute cluster's SK Hynix market cap ($602bn) conflicts with a May 2026 report of $1tn; check. CoreWeave's $2bn NVIDIA stake is verified in str-coreweave-nvidia-2bn. Aggregators (Mean CEO, Wccftech, Rallies, 36Kr, Xenospectrum, Tom's Hardware) are secondary.
